candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so deposits are never credited to the caller's balance.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so each deposit overwrites the balance instead of accumulating.
Replace the ternary assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so a past unlock time is stored instead of clamping to block.timestamp.
Delete the `LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put");` call so Put no longer records a log entry in the Log contract's History.
Delete the statement that deducts _am from acc.balance, so funds can be withdrawn without decreasing the recorded balance.
Remove the `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` condition from the withdrawal guard so withdrawals are allowed before the unlock time.
Replace the `else {revert (); }` branch with `else {acc.balance += _am;}` so a failed external call no longer reverts but instead restores the balance, changing the observable state after Collect.
Delete the statement `acc.balance += msg.value;` so the caller's balance is never increased by the deposit.
Replace `acc.balance += msg.value;` with `acc.balance = msg.value;` so the balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with `acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime;` so unlock times in the past are accepted.
Insert `acc.unlockTime = block.timestamp + 1 days;` after the balance update so the unlock time is forced to one day in the future.
Delete the balance update statement so the sender's stored balance is never decreased after a withdrawal.
Replace `acc.balance - _am` with `acc.balance` so withdrawal leaves the recorded balance unchanged.
Delete the time-lock check `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` so funds can be collected before the unlock time.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful collections are no longer recorded in the log's History.
Change the amount check `acc.balance>=_am` to `acc.balance>_am` so collecting the exact full balance is disallowed.
